defects.D1_hardcoded_ceiling: runtime.py:201 / backends.py:228 / config.py:129 / engine.py:967 / engine.py:1207 each carry an independent 32768 literal. None is derived from the model's real 262144 ceiling.
defects.D2_divisor_invisible: Nothing in HCLI computes n_ctx/n_parallel. HCLI believes it holds 32768 while llama-server hands each slot 11008.
defects.D3_no_preflight: The budget violation surfaces as an HTTP 400 from the model server instead of a structured pre-inference diagnostic.
defects.D4_no_discovery: No /props attach path. A llama-server already running with per-slot n_ctx=262144 is invisible to HCLI, which spawns its own at 32768.
defects.D5_evidence_budget_sized_against_wrong_c: engine._evidence_char_budget derives the admission budget from 32768 while the runtime hands the request 11008. The evidence subsystem is therefore licensed to admit ~3x more context than can ever be sent, and it uses that licence fully: 76.4% of the failing 23532-token request was inlined evidence.
